mn50:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
mn50:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno abbhokāse caṅkamati.
mn50:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena Māro pāpimā āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa kucchigato hoti koṭṭhamanupaviṭṭho.
mn50:2.4: Kin-nu kho me kucchi garugaru viya
mn50:2.6: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno caṅkamā orohitvā vihāraṃ pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn50:3.1: Nisajja kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno paccattaṃ yoniso manasikāsi.
mn50:3.2: Addasā kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ kucchigataṃ koṭṭham-anupaviṭṭhaṃ,
mn50:3.7: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn50:4.2: Ajānam-eva kho maṃ ayaṃ samaṇo apassaṃ evam-āha:
mn50:4.6: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn50:4.7: Yo pi 'ssa so satthā so pi maṃ n' eva khippaṃ jāneyya, kuto pana maṃ ayaṃ sāvako jānissatīti.
mn50:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn50:5.2: Evam-pi kho tāhaṃ pāpima jānāmi, mā tvaṃ maññittho:
mn50:5.6: ajānam-eva kho maṃ ayaṃ samaṇo apassaṃ evam-āha:
mn50:5.10: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti;
mn50:5.11: yo pi 'ssa so satthā so pi maṃ n' eva khippaṃ jāneyya, kuto pana maṃ ayaṃ sāvako jānissatīti.
mn50:6.2: Jānam-eva kho maṃ ayaṃ samaṇo passaṃ evam-āha:
mn50:6.6: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn50:6.7: Atha kho Māro pāpimā āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa mukhato uggantvā paccaggaḷe aṭṭhāsi. \ [...
mn50:7.1: content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ Addasā kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ paccaggaḷe ṭhitaṃ,
mn50:7.3: Ettha pi kho tāhaṃ pāpima passāmi, mā tvaṃ maññittho:
mn50:8.1: Bhūtapubbāhaṃ pāpima Dūsī nāma māro ahosiṃ, tassa me Kāḷī nāma bhaginī,
mn50:9.1: Tena kho pana pāpima samayena Kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
mn50:9.2: Kakusandhassa kho pana pāpima bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Vidhura-Sañjīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
mn50:9.3: Yāvatā kho pana pāpima Kakusandhassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sāvakā
mn50:9.4: nāssu 'dha koci āyasmatā Vidhurena samasamo hoti yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya.
mn50:9.5: Iminā kho etaṃ pāpima pariyāyena āyasmato Vidhurassa Vidhuro Vidhuro t' eva samaññā udapādi.
mn50:10.1: Āyasmā pana pāpima Sañjīvo araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi appakasiren' eva saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjati.
mn50:10.2: Bhūtapubbaṃ pāpima āyasmā Sañjīvo aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno nisinno hoti.
mn50:10.3: Addasāsuṃ kho pāpima gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino āyasmantaṃ Sañjīvaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannaṃ nisinnaṃ,
mn50:10.5: Acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
mn50:10.8: Atha kho te pāpima gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino tiṇañ-ca kaṭṭhañ-ca gomayañ-ca saṅkaḍḍhitvā āyasmato Sañjīvassa kāye upacinitvā aggiṃ datvā pakkamiṃsu.
mn50:11.1: Atha kho pāpima āyasmā Sañjīvo tassā rattiyā accayena tāya samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā cīvarāni papphoṭetvā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn50:11.2: Addasāsuṃ kho te pāpima gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino āyasmantaṃ Sañjīvaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
mn50:11.4: Acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
mn50:11.5: ayaṃ samaṇo nisinnako va kālakato, svāyaṃ patisañjīvito ti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn50:11.6: Iminā kho etaṃ pāpima pariyāyena āyasmato Sañjīvassa Sañjīvo Sañjīvo t' eva samaññā udapādi.
mn50:12.1: Atha kho pāpima Dūsissa mārassa etad-ahosi:
mn50:12.2: Imesaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sīlavantānaṃ kalyāṇadhammānaṃ n' eva jānāmi āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā,
mn50:12.4: etha tumhe bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme akkosatha paribhāsatha rosetha vihesetha,
mn50:12.5: app eva nāma tumhehi akkosiyamānānaṃ paribhāsiyamānānaṃ rosiyamānānaṃ vihesiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ yathā naṃ Dūsī māro labhetha otāran-ti.
mn50:12.6: Atha kho te pāpima Dūsī māro brāhmaṇagahapatike anvāvisi:
mn50:12.8: aññathattaṃ yathā naṃ Dūsī māro labhetha otāran-ti.
mn50:13.1: Atha kho te pāpima brāhmaṇagahapatikā anvāviṭṭhā Dūsinā mārena bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti:
mn50:13.2: Ime pana muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā: jhāyino 'smā jhāyino 'smā ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
mn50:13.3: Seyyathā pi nāma ulūko rukkhasākhāyaṃ mūsikaṃ magayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.4: evam-ev' ime muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibohā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā: jhāyino 'smā jhāyino 'smā ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
mn50:13.5: Seyyathā pi nāma kotthu nadītīre macche magayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.7: Seyyathā pi nāma biḷāro sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre mūsikaṃ magayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.9: Seyyathā pi nāma gadrabho vahacchinno sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.10: evam-ev' ime muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā: jhāyino 'smā jhāyino 'smā ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
mn50:13.11: Ye kho pana pāpima tena samayena manussā kālaṃ karonti yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
mn50:14.1: Atha kho pāpima Kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn50:14.2: Anvāviṭṭhā kho bhikkhave brāhmaṇagahapatikā Dūsinā mārena:
mn50:14.3: etha tumhe bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme akkosatha paribhāsatha rosetha vihesetha, app-eva nāma tumhehi akkosiyamānānaṃ paribhāsiyamānānaṃ rosiyamānānaṃ vihesiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ yathā naṃ Dūsī māro labhetha otāran-ti.
mn50:14.4: Etha tumhe bhikkhave mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham-adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharatha;
mn50:14.7: cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham-adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharathāti.
mn50:15.1: Atha kho te pāpima bhikkhū Kakusandhena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā araññagatā pi rukkhamūlagatā pi suññāgāragatā pi mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham-adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā vihariṃsu,
mn50:15.4: cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham-adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā vihariṃsu.

mn50:16.3: etha tumhe bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme sakkarotha garukarotha mānetha pūjetha, \ [...

mn50:18.1: Atha kho pāpima Kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn50:18.2: Anvāviṭṭhā kho bhikkhave brāhmaṇagahapatikā Dūsinā mārena:
mn50:18.3: etha tumhe bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme sakkarotha garukarotha mānetha pūjetha,
mn50:18.4: app-eva nāma tumhehi sakkariyamānānaṃ garukariyamānānaṃ māniyamānānaṃ pūjiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ yathā naṃ Dūsī māro labhetha otāranti.
mn50:18.5: Etha tumhe bhikkhave asubhānupassī kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassino ti.
mn50:19.1: Atha kho te pāpima bhikkhū Kakusandhena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā araññagatā pi rukkhamūlagatā pi suññāgāragatā pi asubhānupassī kāye vihariṃsu, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassino.
mn50:20.1: Atha kho pāpima Kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā Vidhurena pacchāsamaṇena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn50:21.1: Atha kho pāpima Dūsī māro aññataraṃ kumāraṃ anvāvisitvā sakkharaṃ gahetvā āyasmato Vidhurassa sīse pahāraṃ adāsi, sīsaṃ vobhindi.
mn50:21.2: Atha kho pāpima āyasmā Vidhuro bhinnena sīsena lohitena gaḷantena Kakusandhaṃ yeva bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn50:21.3: Atha kho pāpima Kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāgāpalokitaṃ apalokesi:
mn50:21.5: Sahāpalokanāya ca pana pāpima Dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ-ca upapajji.
mn50:22.1: Tassa kho pana pāpima mahānirayassa tayo nāmadheyyā honti:
mn50:22.2: chaphassāyataniko iti pi, saṅkusamāhato iti pi, paccattavedaniyo iti pi.
mn50:22.3: Atha kho maṃ pāpima nirayapālā upasaṅkamitvā etad-avocuṃ:
mn50:22.4: Yadā kho te mārisa saṅkunā saṅku hadaye samāgaccheyya,
mn50:23.1: So kho ahaṃ pāpima bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni tasmiṃ mahāniraye apacciṃ,
mn50:23.2: dasa vassasahassāni tass' eva mahānirayassa ussade apacciṃ vuṭṭhānimaṃ nāma vedanaṃ vediyamāno.
mn50:23.3: Tassa mayhaṃ pāpima evarūpo kāyo hoti seyyathā pi manussassa,
mn50:23.4: evarūpaṃ sīsaṃ hoti seyyathā pi macchassa.
